# Ilune

> Open-source, self-hosted security posture management for non-human identities and AI agents.

Ilune discovers service principals, API keys, tokens, and AI agents across cloud and identity providers, mapping who owns them, what they can access, and where stale or over-privileged identities create risk. Launching with support for Microsoft Entra ID and Azure. Coming soon.

## Key facts

- **Open source:** Free to use and self-hosted. Scans run inside your own infrastructure, so access credentials and identity data never leave your network.
- **Inventory:** Tracks non-human identities alongside their owners, credentials, and permissions, starting with Microsoft Entra ID and Azure.
- **Read-only:** Never creates, modifies, rotates, or deletes anything in your environment, and never stores secret values.
